https://www.inquirer.net/496735/ph-boost.body: The three-day summit, held in Manila from Nov. 15 to 17, ended without the breakthrough President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. had hoped to achieve, with negotiations on the COC remaining 80% complete. Chester Cabalza, president of the think tank International Development and Security Cooperation, said the West Philippine Sea, which the Philippines claims based on provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, became a central focus of the negotiations. Marcos wanted the COC completed as the country hosted the 49th Asean Summit, with Palace Press Office spokesperson Claire Castro saying the President hoped an agreement would be reached before the Philippines turned over the Asean chairmanship to Singapore. READ: Marcos wants South China Sea code of conduct finalized during Asean Cabalza told the Inquirer that while the Philippines attempted to balance diplomatic conciliation with China on paper, “unresolved debates over the COC’s legally binding nature, geographic scope, and the inclusion of the 2016 arbitral award” prevented Manila from sealing the deal. The Philippines, which has faced direct confrontations with China over the West Philippine Sea in recent years, had pushed for a legally binding agreement that would establish clear rules of conduct in the South China Sea and prevent maritime incidents from escalating into armed confrontations. The COC was 50% complete when the country assumed the chairmanship this year, the Department of Foreign Affairs said. The department highlighted the “substantial completion of the negotiations” on the document, with Asean and China reaching a “provisional agreement on about 80% of the paragraphs.” READ: Marcos thanks Asean, China for remaining committed to finishing COC READ: Failure to finalize South China Sea code was expected – expert Cabalza said the negotiations were constrained by Asean’s consensus-based and noninterference decision-making system, which allows individual member states to influence or prevent the adoption of agreements. He cited Laos as an example of a country that could exercise considerable leverage under the consensus rule. This, he said, could potentially affect the strength of the final document and result in language more favorable to China. Cabalza also stressed that Singapore’s 2027 chairmanship was not guaranteed to prioritize maritime security, saying it could instead focus on other regional initiatives that may be easier to advance, including climate-related cooperation and environmental agreements concerning the high seas. The unresolved issues raise questions about whether the momentum generated during the Philippines’ chairmanship can be sustained or whether negotiations will face further delays next year or beyond, given Asean’s consensus-based decision-making process and the differing political and economic interests of its member states. Despite failing to meet the deadline, the Philippines offset the lack of a binding Asean-China agreement on conduct in the South China Sea by securing bilateral security commitments on the sidelines of the summit, including a new defense agreement with Australia. The agreement provides a framework for deeper cooperation in maritime domain awareness, littoral operations, logistics and sustainment, cyber defense, secure communications, joint operations planning, force protection and defense infrastructure development. Japan also emerged as an important security partner during the Philippines’ Asean chairmanship, with discussions focusing on strengthening defense cooperation and improving the country’s maritime capabilities. During the summit, Japan indicated that it was seeking to accelerate negotiations on the possible transfer of destroyers to the Philippine Navy. The Philippines’ security discussions during the summit also coincided with the visit of U.S. President Donald Trump, who met with Marcos in Malacañang on Nov. 18. The two leaders reaffirmed the longstanding alliance between Manila and Washington, anchored in the 1951 Mutual Defense Treaty. During their meeting, Trump was asked about his level of concern over tensions in the West Philippine Sea and the readiness of the United States should the Philippines invoke the defense agreement. https://www.inquirer.net/496735/ph-boost.title_zh: 在南海行为准则谈判停滞之际，菲律宾加强防务关系
https://www.inquirer.net/496735/ph-boost.body_zh: 这场于11月15日至17日在马尼拉举行的三天峰会结束时，并未实现菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯二世所期望的突破，有关《行为准则》的谈判仍有80%尚未完成。智库International Development and Security Cooperation主席切斯特·卡巴尔萨表示，菲律宾依据《联合国海洋法公约》相关条款提出主权主张的西菲律宾海，成为谈判的核心焦点。马科斯希望在该国主办第49届东盟峰会期间完成《行为准则》。总统府新闻办公室发言人克莱尔·卡斯特罗表示，总统希望菲律宾在将东盟主席国职位移交给新加坡之前达成协议。阅读：马科斯希望在东盟任内敲定南海行为准则。卡巴尔萨告诉《菲律宾询问者报》，虽然菲律宾试图在书面上平衡与中国的外交和解，但“围绕《行为准则》是否具有法律约束力、适用地理范围以及是否纳入2016年仲裁裁决的未决争论”，使马尼拉无法敲定协议。近年来，菲律宾因西菲律宾海问题多次与中国发生直接对峙，并一直推动达成具有法律约束力的协议，以确立南海明确的行为规则，防止海上事件升级为武装冲突。菲律宾外交部表示，该国今年接任东盟主席国时，《行为准则》的完成度为50%。该部门强调，菲律宾和中国已就文件中的“约80%的段落达成临时协议”，表明谈判已“取得实质性进展”。阅读：马科斯感谢东盟和中国继续致力于完成《行为准则》。阅读：专家称，南海行为准则未能如期敲定在意料之中。卡巴尔萨说，谈判受到东盟以共识为基础且不干涉内政的决策体系制约，该体系允许个别成员国影响或阻止协议的通过。他以老挝为例，说明成员国在共识规则下能够发挥相当大的影响力。他说，这可能影响最终文件的力度，并导致其中出现更有利于中国的措辞。卡巴尔萨还强调，新加坡2027年担任东盟主席国时未必会把海上安全列为优先事项，而可能侧重于更容易推进的其他区域倡议，包括气候相关合作以及涉及公海的环境协议。鉴于东盟以共识为基础的决策程序，以及成员国之间不同的政治和经济利益，上述未决问题引发了人们对菲律宾任主席国期间所积累势头能否延续的疑问，也不禁令人担忧谈判明年或更长时间之后是否还会进一步延误。尽管未能如期完成具有约束力的东盟—中国南海行为准则，菲律宾仍在峰会期间通过争取双边安全承诺，弥补缺乏东盟—中国约束性协议所留下的缺口，其中包括与澳大利亚达成的一项新防务协议。该协议为双方在海上态势感知、沿岸行动、后勤保障、网络防御、安全通信、联合行动规划、部队防护和防务基础设施开发等方面深化合作提供了框架。在菲律宾担任东盟主席国期间，日本也成为重要的安全伙伴，双方讨论重点是加强防务合作以及提升菲律宾的海上能力。峰会上，日本表示正寻求加快可能向菲律宾海军转让驱逐舰的谈判。菲律宾在峰会期间展开的安全讨论，还与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的到访同步进行。特朗普于11月18日在马拉卡尼昂宫与马科斯会面。两位领导人重申了马尼拉与华盛顿之间以1951年《共同防御条约》为基础的长期同盟关系。会谈期间，有人询问特朗普对西菲律宾海紧张局势的关注程度，以及在菲律宾启动防务协议时美国是否准备采取行动。他的回答很简短：“我完全不担心。我对此毫不担心。那会得到处理的。”/dm 如需全面报道和深入分析，请访问我们的西菲律宾海专题页面。阅读文章、视频和专家观点，持续了解最新动态。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/no-m.summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) has dismissed reports alleging that $2.04 billion realised from crude oil cargoes lifted by Duke Oil Company Incorporated, now NNPC Trading S.A., was unaccounted for, insisting that all transactions were fully reconciled. In a statement by its Chief Corporate Communications Officer, Andy Odeh, NNPC said the absence of separate dollar receipts for some cargoes did not indicate missing funds.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/no-m.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）驳斥了有关 Duke Oil Company Incorporated（现为 NNPC Trading S.A.）承运的原油货物实现收入20.4亿美元去向不明的报道，坚称所有交易均已完全核对。NNPC首席企业传播官 Andy Odeh 在声明中表示，部分货物缺少单独的美元收款凭据，并不意味着资金失踪。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/no-m.body: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) has dismissed reports alleging that $2.04 billion realised from crude oil cargoes lifted by Duke Oil Company Incorporated, now NNPC Trading S.A., was unaccounted for, insisting that all transactions were fully reconciled. The company said the $2.04 billion represented the gross value of 29 cargoes whose proceeds were set off against the cost of refined petroleum products supplied to Nigeria under the Direct Sale Direct Purchase (DSDP) programme. In a statement by its Chief Corporate Communications Officer, Andy Odeh, NNPC said the absence of separate dollar receipts for some cargoes did not indicate missing funds. “No separate receipt appears because the crude sale proceeds were set off against the product purchase price, as the contracts provide,” it stated. Under the DSDP programme, participating traders lifted crude oil in exchange for refined petroleum products, including petrol, for the Nigerian market. NNPC explained that while crude was priced in dollars, products supplied were sold in naira, with transactions reconciled and captured in the audited financial statements of the relevant entities. The company said all 59 cargoes referenced in the reports were accounted for, adding that 30 were paid for in dollars, while proceeds from 28 cargoes, valued at approximately $1.96 billion, were remitted in naira to the NNPC Group Treasury or NNPC Upstream Investment Management Services accounts. The remaining cargo, a February 2023 Bonga tax-oil lifting valued at about $75.9 million, was paid into the then designated Federal Inland Revenue Service dollar account. On Duke Oil’s ownership, NNPC said it was incorporated in 1989 as its wholly owned trading subsidiary, adding that the relationship was documented in its corporate history, audited financial statements and NEITI’s 2023 industry report. It maintained that transactions between the company and its subsidiaries were disclosed as related-party transactions under International Financial Reporting Standards. NNPC reaffirmed its commitment to transparency and accountability, but warned that it reserved the right to take legal action against publications it considered false or misleading. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/no-m.title_zh: 20.4亿美元Duke Oil原油货物不存在资金短缺问题
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/no-m.body_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC）否认了有关Duke Oil Company Incorporated（现为NNPC Trading S.A.）提取的原油货物所得20.4亿美元去向不明的说法，并坚称所有交易均已完全核对。公司表示，这20.4亿美元是29船原油货物的总值，其收益已抵扣根据直接销售直接购买（DSDP）计划向尼日利亚供应的精炼石油产品成本。公司首席企业传播官Andy Odeh在声明中表示，NNPC称，部分原油货物没有单独的美元收款，并不意味着资金失踪。“没有单独的收款凭证，是因为原油销售收益按照合同规定抵扣了产品购买价款，”他指出。根据DSDP计划，参与贸易商以提取原油换取面向尼日利亚市场的精炼石油产品，包括汽油。NNPC解释称，原油以美元定价，而供应的石油产品则以奈拉出售，相关交易经过核对，并列入相关实体的经审计财务报表。公司表示，报道提及的全部59船货物均已有着落，其中30船以美元付款，另外28船货物的收益约为19.6亿美元，已以奈拉汇入NNPC集团资金部门或NNPC上游投资管理服务的账户。剩余的一船货物是2023年2月提取的Bonga税油，价值约7590万美元，款项已汇入当时指定的联邦内陆税务局美元账户。关于Duke Oil的所有权，NNPC表示，该公司于1989年成立，是其全资贸易子公司，双方关系记录在公司的企业历史、经审计财务报表以及NEITI的2023年行业报告中。NNPC坚持，公司与其子公司之间的交易已依据国际财务报告准则披露为关联方交易。NNPC重申致力于保持透明和问责，同时警告将保留对其所认为虚假或误导性的出版物采取法律行动的权利。本文所载评论不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的意见

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Samsung SDI said Wednesday that its Ulsan plant has won the Grand Prize at the 2026 Green Management Awards, organized by the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Korea Environmental Industry & Technology Institute (KEITI). The plant received the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment Award in the Excellent Green Company category, which recognizes companies demonstrating outstanding environmental management in areas such as carbon neutrality and resource conservation. The Green Management Awards recognize exemplary achievements in environmental management, environmental information disclosure and environmental, social and governance (ESG) practices. Samsung SDI's Ulsan plant became the first battery industry facility in Korea to receive Green Company designation in 1999 and has maintained the status for 27 consecutive years, reflecting its long-standing commitment to environmentally responsible operations. In April, the plant became the first private-sector facility to be recognized as a high-performing site under the ministry's water conservation program. It reuses 90 percent of its wastewater and has cut annual municipal water consumption by approximately 74,000 cubic meters. The plant is also pursuing carbon neutrality by operating solar power facilities and introducing energy-efficient equipment, reducing its annual greenhouse gas emissions by approximately 5,000 metric tons. In addition, it has earned Platinum certification, the highest level under UL Solutions' Zero Waste to Landfill program, while maintaining a waste recycling rate of more than 99.9 percent. Samsung SDI has also received broader recognition for its ESG performance, including a record 21 inclusions in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class index and an AA rating from MSCI ESG Ratings. “This award recognizes the Ulsan plant's longstanding efforts to improve its environmental performance,” a Samsung SDI official said. “We will continue to advance our environmental management efforts to support sustainable growth and create lasting value for society.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Samsung SDI蔚山工厂荣获绿色管理最高奖项
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: Samsung SDI周三表示，其蔚山工厂获得了由气候、能源和环境部与韩国环境产业技术研究院（KEITI）组织的2026年绿色管理大奖最高奖。该工厂荣获气候、能源和环境部部长奖“优秀绿色企业”类别大奖，表彰那些在碳中和、资源保护等领域展现出卓越环境管理能力的企业。绿色管理大奖旨在认可环境管理、环境信息披露以及环境、社会和治理（ESG）实践方面的卓越成就。Samsung SDI蔚山工厂于1999年成为韩国首家获得“绿色企业”称号的电池行业设施，并连续27年保持这一资格，体现了其长期致力于环境责任运营的承诺。今年4月，该工厂成为该部节水计划下首个获认定为高绩效场所的私营部门设施。工厂重复利用了90%的废水，每年减少市政用水约74,000立方米。该工厂还通过运营太阳能发电设施和引进节能设备来追求碳中和，每年减少温室气体排放约5,000公吨。此外，该工厂还获得了UL Solutions“零废弃物填埋”计划的最高等级——铂金级认证，同时保持超过99.9%的废弃物回收率。Samsung SDI的ESG表现也获得了更广泛认可，其中包括创纪录地21次入选道琼斯最佳管理指数，并获得MSCI ESG评级的AA评级。Samsung SDI一名官员表示：“此次奖项认可了蔚山工厂为改善环境绩效所作的长期努力。我们将继续推进环境管理工作，支持可持续增长并为社会创造持久价值。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: An event aimed at helping Korean companies connect with overseas procurement markets kicked off its two-day run in Seoul on Wednesday, the Public Procurement Service (PPS) said. The Global Public Procurement Marketplace 2026, co-hosted by the PPS, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency and KEPCO KPS, brings together over 110 prospective buyers and more than 330 local companies, the PPS said. This year, PPS has placed particular emphasis on expanding opportunities for domestic companies to enter new overseas public procurement markets, including those of international organizations, and supporting export market diversification. As part of such an initiative, the agency has invited representatives from major UN procurement organizations, including the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR). They are scheduled to hold in-depth, one-on-one consultations with local companies, the state agency explained. The justice ministry has also participated for the first time this year to offer legal consultations related to export contracts. On the sidelines of the event, a showcase of outstanding Korean products will be held until Thursday to promote advanced technologies and products from local firms to overseas procuring entities, the agency added. "As a trusted partner in overseas public procurement, PPS will continue to provide strong support for Korean companies seeking to expand their export reach," Baek Seung-bo, the administrator of the PPS, said. The event is part of the procurement agency's long standing effort to support local small and medium-sized enterprises in gaining access to overseas markets, and is aimed at sustaining Korea's export growth following its historic achievement of reaching $1 trillion in exports early this month, he added
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 全球公共采购市场在首尔启动
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国公共采购服务机构（PPS）表示，一项旨在帮助韩国企业对接海外采购市场的活动于周三在首尔开幕，为期两天。由PPS、韩国外交部、韩国贸易投资促进机构和KEPCO KPS共同主办的“2026全球公共采购市场”汇聚了110多名潜在买家和330多家韩国本地企业。PPS表示，今年尤其重视为韩国企业拓展新的海外公共采购市场，包括国际组织的采购市场，并支持出口市场多元化。作为相关举措的一部分，该机构邀请了联合国开发计划署（UNDP）、联合国难民署（UNHCR）等联合国主要采购机构的代表。他们预计将与韩国本地企业进行深入的一对一 consultations。该国家机构解释道，韩国司法部今年也首次参与活动，为出口合同相关事宜提供法律咨询。该机构补充称，活动期间还将举行优秀韩国产品展示活动，持续至周四，以向海外采购实体推介韩国企业的先进技术和产品。PPS负责人白承模说：“作为海外公共采购领域值得信赖的合作伙伴，PPS将继续大力支持寻求扩大出口覆盖范围的韩国企业。”他补充说，这项活动是采购机构长期以来帮助韩国本地中小企业进入海外市场 efforts 的一部分，旨在延续韩国出口增长势头；韩国本月早些时候实现了出口额达到1万亿美元的历史性突破。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The Ministry of Justice has significantly accelerated the nationality reinstatement process for ethnic Koreans living abroad, cutting the average review time by four months — from 13 months down to nine. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 司法部大幅加快了为居住在海外的朝鲜族恢复国籍的审批流程，将平均审查时间缩短了4个月，从13个月降至9个月。对于办理速度最快的申请人，等待时间最多缩短了7个月，使数千名渴望正式与故土建立联系的人得以迅速办理相关手续。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Ministry of Justice has significantly accelerated the nationality reinstatement process for ethnic Koreans living abroad, cutting the average review time by four months — from 13 months down to nine. For applicants experiencing the fastest processing, wait times have been reduced by as much as seven months, offering swift relief to thousands eager to formally reconnect with their homeland. The breakthrough stems from an intensive, three-month processing campaign conducted between August and October, according to the ministry. Facing a growing backlog fueled by a steady rise in applications from ethnic Koreans living abroad, the ministry overhauled its operational capacity. Previously, a single dedicated officer handled the workload, processing an average of roughly 220 cases per month. By deploying four additional specialists to the team, the ministry dramatically scaled up its output, resolving a total of 4,664 cases over the three-month period. This boosted the monthly average to 1,555 cases — more than seven times the previous pace. For overseas Koreans seeking to restore their citizenship — often retirees returning home or individuals looking to reunite with family and establish long-term roots — lengthy administrative delays have historically created significant uncertainty regarding healthcare, residency, and daily life. By trimming the review period to nine months or less, the government aims to ease the psychological and practical burdens of prolonged waiting, helping returning compatriots settle stably into Korean society. Beyond clearing the immediate backlog, the justice ministry said it is also modernizing how applicants track their cases. Beginning in December, individuals applying for naturalization or nationality reinstatement will be able to check their specific, estimated completion dates directly through the status inquiry portal on HiKorea , the government’s official immigration website. This upgrade eliminates the guesswork that previously left applicants in the dark during months of processing. Acting Minister of Justice Lee Jin-soo emphasized the human impact of the administrative overhaul. "Reducing the nationality reinstatement review period is deeply meaningful because it provides practical support for our compatriots starting a new chapter as citizens of the Republic of Korea," Lee said. He added that the ministry remains committed to expanding its review workforce and strengthening its administrative capabilities to ensure future evaluations are both prompt and thorough. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国将居住在国外的朝鲜族恢复国籍的等待时间缩短至9个月
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 司法部大幅加快了居住在海外的朝鲜族恢复国籍的办理进程，将平均审查时间缩短了四个月，从13个月降至9个月。对于办理速度最快的申请人，等待时间最多缩短了七个月，使数千名渴望正式与祖国重新建立联系的人士迅速获得便利。司法部表示，这一突破得益于8月至10月开展的为期三个月的集中办理行动。面对海外朝鲜族申请数量持续增长所导致的积压案件不断加剧，司法部对自身办案能力进行了全面调整。此前，只有一名专职官员负责相关工作，平均每月处理约220件案件。司法部向团队增派四名专业人员后，处理能力显著提升，在三个月内共办结4,664件案件，使月均处理量增至1,555件，是此前速度的七倍以上。对于希望恢复公民身份的海外朝鲜族人士而言——他们通常是返乡养老的退休人员，或是希望与家人团聚并在当地长期生活的人士——冗长的行政审批延误历来使其在医疗、居留和日常生活方面面临诸多不确定性。通过将审查期缩短至九个月以内，政府旨在减轻长期等待带来的心理和实际负担，帮助返乡同胞稳妥融入韩国社会。司法部表示，除清理当前积压案件外，该部还在现代化申请进度查询方式。自12月起，申请入籍或恢复国籍的人士将可通过韩国政府官方移民网站HiKorea的状态查询门户，直接查询个案预计完成日期。此次升级消除了以往数月办理期间申请人无法了解进度的情况。代理司法部长李进秀强调了行政审批改革对民众生活的意义。李进秀说：“缩短恢复国籍的审查期具有重大意义，因为这为以大韩民国公民身份开启人生新篇章的同胞提供了实际支持。”他还表示，司法部仍致力于扩大审查人员队伍、强化行政能力，确保今后的审查既及时又周全。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: Korean shares extended their losses late Wednesday morning, reversing the previous session's rally, as investors tracked overnight losses in technology stocks on Wall Street. After opening a sharp 3.94 percent lower, the benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) extended its losses, shedding 277.22 points, or 5.54 percent, to 4,728.81 as of 11:20 a.m., and falling below the psychologically important 5,000 mark. As the market lost ground, the Korea Exchange activated a sell-side sidecar at 9:09 a.m., suspending buy orders in program trading for KOSPI-listed shares for five minutes. On Tuesday, the KOSPI rebounded more than 6 percent as chipmakers rallied amid a global wave of optimism sparked by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return to the spotlight. Overnight, U.S. stocks closed mixed as Nvidia gave back part of its historic gains from the previous day and concerns over fresh U.S. tariffs weighed on the tech sector. Market bellwether Samsung Electronics dropped 9.03 percent, while its chipmaking rival SK hynix surrendered 8.55 percent. Among other index heavyweights, SK Square, the parent of SK hynix, fell 10.77, while power equipment manufacturer Samsung Electro-Mechanics shed 9.44 percent. The Korean won was quoted at 1,342.9 won against the U.S. dollar as of 11:20 a.m., up 0.1 won from the previous session's close

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title: Chinese tech giant Huawei is guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets, US jury finds
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: NEW YORK — A U.S. jury convicted Chinese tech giant Huawei Technologies on Tuesday of conspiring to steal trade secrets and defrauding banks as it grew into one of the world’s biggest suppliers of gear for wireless telecommunications networks.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 纽约——美国陪审团周二裁定，中国科技巨头Huawei Technologies犯有共谋窃取商业秘密和欺诈银行罪；随着其发展成为全球最大的无线电信网络设备供应商之一。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: NEW YORK — A U.S. jury convicted Chinese tech giant Huawei Technologies on Tuesday of conspiring to steal trade secrets and defrauding banks as it grew into one of the world’s biggest suppliers of gear for wireless telecommunications networks. But jurors acquitted Huawei of the most serious charge: engaging in a criminal racketeering conspiracy, a result that the company's lawyer said was a “profound rejection” of the government's narrative that it was corrupt from top to bottom and had a corporate culture of cheating, stealing and lying. Prosecutors had used the charge, commonly found in organized crime and drug cases, to accuse Huawei of operating illicitly to poach intellectual property and technological secrets from competitors and partners. The convictions covered allegations that the company did business in countries subject to U.S. sanctions — including Iran and North Korea — and made false statements to U.S. government officials and banks as part of an effort to hide its misdeeds. In all, Huawei was convicted on 10 of 12 counts. The case in Brooklyn federal court involved no human defendants, but the company could be made to pay billions of dollars in penalties when it is sentenced next September. “Few crimes are as serious as Huawei’s decades-long pattern of endangering U.S. national security, violating the sanctity of U.S. commerce, and impeding the enforcement of U.S. laws,” Brooklyn U.S. Attorney Joseph Nocella Jr. said in a statement. “No person or company is above the law,” Attorney General Todd Blanche said. Huawei’s lawyers said U.S. investigators had used isolated episodes of wrongdoing by a few of the company’s more than 200,000 employees to spin a false narrative about a grand conspiracy that didn’t actually exist. Huawei lawyer Brian Heberlig said the company would appeal the convictions but was heartened by the acquittals on racketeering conspiracy and another charge, conspiracy to obstruct justice. He called those not guilty verdicts “a vindication of the company and its good-faith compliance culture.” “The allegations that the government made in this case overreached and simply weren’t consistent with the successful, innovative and hardworking company that we came to know and deeply respect,” Heberlig said outside the courthouse. It's unclear what effect the verdict might have on Huawei's global fortunes. The company hasn't been allowed to sell equipment to U.S. carriers for years because of security concerns. It has also been blacklisted by other Western allies, including Canada and Britain. That hasn't stopped the company from doing a robust business elsewhere. Its smartphones and other telecom equipment are sold globally. More recently, it has expanded into chipmaking as the boom in artificial intelligence fuels demand for microprocessors, becoming an important alternative in China to chips made by companies such as Nvidia. “Huawei has always adhered to integrity in business, upheld business ethics, respected intellectual property, and remained committed to complying with all applicable laws and regulations,” the company said in a statement. “We remain focused on serving our customers and partners and ensuring continuous and stable business operations," the statement said. The U.S. announced its criminal charges against Huawei in early 2019 and later expanded the allegations . The lengthy trial began in September. Chinese officials said the U.S. has engaged in “economic bullying” and improperly used national security as a pretext for oppressing Chinese companies. The US alleged a pattern of theft reaching all the way to the top The indictment against Huawei accused it of a long pattern of outright technology thefts. Huawei, prosecutors said, once sold internet routers containing source code copied from a competitor. In another episode, a person working for Huawei slipped into a competitor's booth at a Chicago trade show to surreptitiously photograph the circuits inside another company's networking device, the indictment said. Prosecutors said that on another occasion, a Huawei worker removed a robotic arm from a competitor's lab so it could be photographed and measured. The victim companies included Cisco Systems, Motorola Solutions, T-Mobile, Quintel USA and Fujitsu, according to court records. “The tone was set at the top by Huawei leaders and executives who themselves engaged in criminal conduct, like lying to Congress, lying to banks, violating U.S. sanctions and trying to interfere with the very criminal investigation that led to this case,” prosecutor Meredith Arfa told the jury at the trial. In its statement, Huawei referred to those matters as “trade secret-related disputes” that were the subject of civil litigation that was resolved over the past two decades. “No court ever found Huawei liable for willful intellectual property misappropriation, and the company was never ordered to pay damages for trade secret misappropriation,” the company said. Huawei says it isn’t defined by isolated allegations of wrongdoing In his closing argument to jurors, Huawei's lawyer said prosecutors leaned on “innuendo and facts ripped out of context,” and testimony from ex-employees “with a bone to pick,” to pursue a company that had relied on “hard work, innovation and competition” to succeed. “Huawei didn’t steal its way to success,” Heberlig said, noting that much of the material the U.S. alleges was stolen was already public. He said Huawei paid billions of dollars in licensing fees over the years, with 75% of that money going to U.S. companies, and had reprimanded or fired employees found to have engaged in wrongdoing. Heberlig noted that lines of Cisco source code turned up in Huawei software more than two decades ago. He said when the source-code copying was discovered, Huawei recalled routers sold in the U.S. and offered to replace them with Cisco routers and created a “compliance culture that permeates Huawei today.” No individual executives or employees faced trial, although prosecutors at one point also brought criminal charges against Huawei's chief financial officer, Meng Wanzhou . They accused her of misleading HSBC bank about the company’s business dealings in Iran. Meng, the daughter of Huawei’s founder, was arrested in Canada in 2018, but ultimately was allowed to return to China in 2021 in a prisoner swap that freed two Canadians held by China. As part of the deal, the U.S. dropped its case against Meng. The trial in New York overlapped with a summit between President Donald Trump , China’s Xi Jinping and Russia’s Vladimir Putin in the technology-centric city of Shenzhen, China
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国陪审团裁定，中国科技巨头华为犯有窃取商业秘密的共谋罪
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 纽约——一个美国陪审团周二裁定，中国科技巨头Huawei Technologies犯有共谋窃取商业秘密和欺诈银行的罪名；随着该公司成长为全球最大的无线电信网络设备供应商之一，这些指控随之而来。但陪审员免除了华为最严重的罪名，即参与犯罪性敲诈勒索共谋。华为的律师称，这一结果是对政府所谓“华为从上到下都腐败不堪、形成了欺骗、偷窃和撒谎的企业文化”这一叙事的“深度否定”。检方曾利用这一常见于有组织犯罪和毒品案件的指控，指控华为违法经营，以窃取竞争对手和合作伙伴的知识产权及技术秘密。这些定罪涉及的指控包括：华为与受美国制裁的国家开展业务，包括伊朗和朝鲜；并向美国政府官员和银行作出虚假陈述，以掩盖其不当行为。华为在12项指控中的10项上被判有罪。布鲁克林联邦法院审理的此案没有人类被告，但明年9月宣判时，华为可能被处以数十亿美元罚款。布鲁克林联邦检察官Joseph Nocella Jr.在一份声明中说：“很少有罪行像华为长达数十年的行为模式一样严重，这些行为危及美国国家安全、破坏美国商业的尊严并妨碍美国法律的执行。”司法部长Todd Blanche说：“任何个人或公司都不凌驾于法律之上。”华为的律师说，美国调查人员利用公司20多万名员工中少数人的零散不当行为，炮制了一套并不存在的宏大阴谋叙事。华为律师Brian Heberlig说，公司将对定罪提出上诉，但对敲诈勒索共谋以及另一项妨碍司法共谋指控获判无罪感到欣慰。他称，这些无罪裁决证明“公司和其诚信合规文化获得了正名”。Heberlig在法院外说：“政府在本案中提出的指控越了界，也与我们逐步认识并深切尊重的这家成功、创新和勤奋的公司根本不符。”目前尚不清楚这一裁决会对华为的全球发展产生何种影响。多年来，由于安全方面的担忧，华为一直无法向美国运营商销售设备。它也遭到包括加拿大和英国在内的其他西方盟友列入黑名单。但这并未妨碍该公司在其他地方蓬勃开展业务。其智能手机和其他电信设备在全球销售。最近，随着人工智能热潮推动微处理器需求，华为还扩展到芯片制造领域，成为中国市场上一款可替代Nvidia等公司芯片的重要选择。华为在一份声明中说：“华为始终恪守商业诚信，坚守商业道德，尊重知识产权，并始终致力于遵守所有适用的法律法规。”声明说：“我们将继续专注于服务客户和合作伙伴，确保业务持续稳定运营。”美国于2019年初宣布对华为提出刑事指控，后来又扩大了指控范围。这场漫长的审判于9月开始。中国官员称，美国搞“经济霸凌”，并不当利用国家安全作为压迫中国企业的借口。美国指控存在一路延伸至高层的盗窃行为模式。对华为的起诉书指控其长期赤裸裸地窃取技术。检方称，华为曾销售过含有从竞争对手复制的源代码的互联网路由器。起诉书说，另一次事件中，一名华为工作人员潜入竞争对手在芝加哥贸易展会上设立的展台，秘密拍摄另一家公司网络设备内部的电路。检方说，还有一次，一名华为工作人员从竞争对手的实验室搬走一条机器人手臂，以便对其拍照和测量。根据法院记录，受害公司包括Cisco Systems、Motorola Solutions、T-Mobile、Quintel USA和Fujitsu。检察官Meredith Arfa在庭审中告诉陪审员：“基调是由华为的高层领导和高管定下的，他们本人也参与刑事犯罪活动，比如向国会撒谎、向银行撒谎、违反美国制裁，并试图干扰最终促成此案的刑事调查。”华为在声明中把这些事件称为“与商业秘密有关的纠纷”，相关民事诉讼已在此前20年间得到解决。公司说：“从没有任何法院认定华为对故意侵占知识产权负有责任，也从未命令公司就商业秘密侵占行为支付赔偿金。”华为表示，零散的不当行为指控并不能定义公司。在向陪审团作结案陈词时，华为的律师说，检方依赖“含沙射影和断章取义的事实”，以及与华为“有过节”的前员工的证词，妄图追究一家依靠“努力、创新和竞争”取得成功的公司。“华为没有靠偷窃走向成功，”Heberlig说，并指出美国所称许多被盗材料早已公开。他说，华为多年来支付了数十亿美元许可费，其中75%的资金流向美国公司；公司还曾对被发现从事不当行为的员工进行训诫或解雇。Heberlig指出，20多年前，Cisco的源代码曾出现在华为软件中。他说，源代码复制行为被发现后，华为召回了在美国销售的路由器，并提出用Cisco路由器予以更换，还建立了“贯穿华为今天的合规文化”。没有个别高管或员工出庭受审，不过检方一度也对华为首席财务官Meng Wanzhou提出刑事指控。他们指控她在公司对伊朗的业务往来方面误导HSBC银行。Meng是华为创始人的女儿，2018年在加拿大被捕，但最终于2021年获准返回中国；当时双方达成换俘协议，中国释放了两名被扣押的加拿大公民。作为协议的一部分，美国撤销了对Meng的案件。纽约这场审判与一场峰会时间重叠；美国总统Donald Trump、中国国家主席Xi Jinping和俄罗斯总统Vladimir Putin在中国以科技闻名的城市深圳举行了会晤。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — North Korea's latest expansion of a uranium enrichment facility at its Yongbyon nuclear complex may be aimed at increasing its production of weapons-grade uranium, a U.S. research institute assessed Tuesday. The Washington-based Institute for Science and International Security (ISIS) made the assessment in a report based on satellite imagery of the facility, located some 100 kilometers north of Pyongyang, whose rapid expansion has drawn concern from the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA). The institute said satellite imagery of the newly built extension indicated that it consists primarily of a large hall without internal dividing walls, raising the possibility that it could accommodate additional uranium enrichment equipment. "Another possibility is that the added hall is designed specifically to make weapon-grade uranium (WGU)," the report said. Other possible purposes include increasing low-enriched uranium production, expanding operational support for existing enrichment facilities or accommodating research and development activities, according to the report. Satellite imagery showed that construction of the extension began in September and progressed rapidly, the institute said. North Korea has previously expanded its original uranium enrichment plant at Yongbyon twice, with the first expansion taking place in 2013 and the second beginning in the 2021-22 period, according to the institute. IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi raised concern over the rapidly built extension on Nov. 18, although the U.N. nuclear watchdog did not provide an assessment of its intended purpose
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 美国科学研究所称，朝鲜龙川核设施扩建可能提高武器级铀产量
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 华盛顿——一家美国研究机构周二评估称，朝鲜最近扩建位于甏普 nuclear complex的浓缩铀设施，可能旨在增加武器级铀的产量。位于华盛顿的科学与国际安全研究所（ISIS）在一份报告中作出了这一评估。该报告以该设施的卫星图像为依据。设施位于平壤以北约100公里处，其快速扩建已引起国际原子能机构（IAEA）的关注。研究所称，新建扩建部分的卫星图像显示，它主要由一座没有内部隔墙的大型厂房构成，因此可能容纳更多浓缩铀设备。报告称：“另一种可能是，新增厂房专门用于制造武器级铀（WGU）。”据报告称，其他可能的用途包括增加低浓缩铀产量、为现有浓缩设施扩大运行支持，或容纳研究与开发活动。研究所称，卫星图像显示，扩建工程于9月开工并迅速推进。据该研究所介绍，朝鲜此前曾两次扩建位于甏普的原有浓缩铀厂，第一次扩建发生在2013年，第二次始于2021年至2022年期间。国际原子能机构总干事拉斐尔·格罗西于11月18日对这项迅速建成的扩建工程表示担忧，但这家联合国核监督机构没有就其预期用途作出评估

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: From local comfort food to global franchise: Chinese malatang king's Korea test
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: This is the first in a six-part interview series exploring how Chinese consumer brands are expanding into Korea, one of Asia’s most competitive markets. Through conversations with founders and senior executives, the series examines their market-entry strategies, local challenges and ambitions to build global brands that resonate with consumers beyond China.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 这是探讨中国消费品牌如何拓展韩国市场的六篇访谈系列第一篇。韩国是亚洲竞争最激烈的市场之一。通过与创始人及高级管理人员对话，本系列考察他们进入市场的策略、面临的本地挑战，以及打造能够吸引中国以外消费者的全球品牌的雄心。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: This is the first in a six-part interview series exploring how Chinese consumer brands are expanding into Korea, one of Asia’s most competitive markets. Through conversations with founders and senior executives, the series examines their market-entry strategies, local challenges and ambitions to build global brands that resonate with consumers beyond China. At around 7 p.m. on a recent Monday, more than half of the dozen or so tables were occupied at a Yangguofu Malatang restaurant in Yeoksam, an office-packed area in Seoul's Gangnam District. Vegetables, fish balls, rice cakes and instant noodles lined a refrigerated self-service topping bar, while pickled radish, peanuts and dipping sauces were available nearby. Two employees juggled cooking, payments, serving and clearing tables in the orange-hued restaurant. Yangguofu Group, one of China's largest malatang chains with nearly 7,000 outlets worldwide, has grown its overseas network from just over 20 in early 2023 to more than 200 across 30 countries and territories, as it steps up its global expansion. Yet the company is a much smaller player in Korea, where malatang — which literally translates to “numbing, spicy, scalding-hot” — found a receptive audience in a country fond of spicy food and hot soups. The dish has become popular enough to be proposed for inclusion in the country’s consumer price index basket. Yangguofu entered the Korean market in 2019 and now has 10 outlets, all franchised, according to its website - less than half its peak store count. Zhu Hongzhen, its global chief supervisor and head of the brand centre, described the contraction as a strategic choice from adding stores to improving their performance. "Opening more stores is not our primary goal," he said. "What matters is the quality and making sure franchisees can make profits." The efforts include upgrading outlets to the latest orange-colored interior — the “sixth-generation design” as the company puts it — to diversifying soup options and adding dishes such as fried rice and guobaorou, a Chinese sweet-and-sour pork dish to suit local tastes. Prospective franchisees are assessed on restaurant experience, financial resources and location. Zhu estimated that a Korean outlet could recoup its initial investment in about a year, depending on operating condition. Zhu said Yangguofu would prioritize quality over scale in Korea, resuming expansion only once the malatang market showed signs of recovery and its localization efforts met internal targets. The company also faces competition from established chains, including Tanghuo Kungfu and Chunli, as well as numerous independent operators. Facing these challenges, Yangguofu sees "consistency of flavour" as its competitive edge. Its signature herbal bone broth base is made at a company-owned factory in Chengdu, Sichuan province, while franchisees source most fresh ingredients locally. The company provides training and operational guidance ahead of store openings. The model, combining standardized production with local execution, underpins its wider overseas plan. "In the past, Chinese food largely followed migrants overseas, who opened restaurants to make a living," Zhu said. "Now, chains are expanding systematically," drawing on regional teams, supply chains, research and development, and marketing expertise. The push has also gained government backing. In 2024, Beijing issued guidelines encouraging restaurant operators to expand overseas. Shanghai, where Yangguofu is headquartered, has since introduced initiatives offering overseas market guidance, regulatory assistance and supply-chain support. Yangguofu is focusing on Britain, France and Germany, the eastern United States and Asian markets including Japan, Korea, Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand. It has established six overseas warehouses and plans regional "central kitchens" once local store networks reach sufficient scale, allowing fresh and frozen ingredients to be centrally prepared and distributed. The company is also tailoring its offerings, from curry-flavored broth in the U.S. to tom yum in Europe, while developing halal-compliant production capacity for certain markets. Company-operated outlets also serve as showcases. At its London Chinatown flagship, a basement entertainment space has hosted stand-up comedy, part of an effort to turn restaurants into social destinations. After years of investment in infrastructure building and branding, Zhu said the overseas business could break even this year. But the ambition extends beyond selling more bowls of malatang. Yangguofu hopes to introduce Chinese concepts of food as nourishment, herbal ingredients and cultural symbolism to overseas consumers, while becoming part of their everyday dining habits. How much of that culture can travel with the food remains "an open question," Zhu acknowledged. Wency Chen is a reporter with the South China Morning Post. Currently away from her home base in Shanghai, she is based in Seoul, reporting for both The Korea Times and the SCMP as part of an exchange program
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 从本地暖心美食到全球连锁：麻辣烫巨头在韩国的考验
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 这是六篇系列访谈的第一篇 explores 中国消费品牌如何拓展亚洲最具竞争力的市场之一——韩国。通过与创始人及高级管理人员对话，本系列考察他们进入市场的策略、面临的本地挑战，以及打造能赢得中国以外消费者青睐的全球品牌的雄心。前不久一个星期晚上7点左右，首尔江南区办公楼密集的猎鹰洞一家杨国福麻辣烫餐厅里，十几张餐桌中已有过半座满。冷藏自助配料台上摆着蔬菜、鱼丸、米糕和方便面，旁边还有腌萝卜、花生和蘸料。两名员工在这家橙色调餐厅里同时忙于烹饪、收银、上菜和收拾餐桌。杨国福集团是中国规模最大的麻辣烫连锁品牌之一，在全球拥有近7000家门店。随着公司加快全球扩张，其海外门店网络已从2023年初的20多家增至30个国家和地区的200多家。然而，在韩国，杨国福仍是一家规模小得多的经营者。麻辣烫字面意思是“麻辣、滚烫”，在这个喜爱辣食和热汤的国家找到了乐于接受的受众。这道菜已广受欢迎，以至于有人提议将其纳入该国消费者价格指数的篮子。杨国福于2019年进入韩国市场，如今有10家门店，且全部采取加盟模式 according to its website——不到其门店数量峰值的一半。其全球 chief supervisor 兼品牌中心负责人朱鸿真将这一收缩描述为一项战略选择：从增加门店转向改善门店表现。“开设更多门店不是我们的首要目标，”他说，“重要的是品质，并确保加盟商能够盈利。”这些工作包括将门店升级为最新的橙色内装——公司称之为“第六代设计”——丰富汤底选择，并加入炒饭和锅包肉等菜品，以迎合当地口味。公司会从餐厅体验、财务资源和选址等方面评估潜在加盟商。朱估计，视经营状况而定，一家韩国门店大约一年即可收回初始投资。朱表示，杨国福在韩国将把品质置于规模之上，只有在麻辣烫市场显现复苏迹象、且本地化工作达到内部目标后，才会重启扩张。公司还面临来自唐火功夫、春丽等成熟连锁品牌以及众多独立经营者的竞争。面对这些挑战，杨国福将“口味一致性”视为其竞争优势。其标志性的草本骨汤底料在四川省成都市一家公司自有工厂生产，而加盟商则从当地采购大部分新鲜食材。公司会在门店开业前提供培训和运营指导。这种将标准化生产与本地执行相结合的模式，支撑着其更广泛的海外计划。“过去，中国餐饮主要是跟着出海的移民走，他们开餐厅谋生，”朱说，“如今，连锁品牌正在系统性扩张”，并借鉴区域团队、供应链、研发和营销方面的经验。这项推进还获得了政府支持。2024年，北京发布指导意见，鼓励餐饮企业向海外扩张。杨国福总部所在的上海此后推出了多项举措，为企业提供海外市场指导、监管协助和供应链支持。杨国福正重点关注英国、法国、德国、美国东部，以及包括日本、韩国、新加坡、马来西亚和泰国在内的亚洲市场。公司已设立6座海外仓库，并计划在当地门店网络达到一定规模后设立区域“中央厨房”，集中制作和配送新鲜及冷冻食材。公司还在调整产品，例如在美国提供咖喱风味汤底，在欧洲提供冬阴功汤，同时为某些市场开发符合清真要求的产能。公司直营门店也充当展示窗口。在其伦敦唐人街旗舰店里，地下娱乐空间已举办过单口喜剧表演，这是公司将餐厅打造为社交场所的一部分努力。朱表示，在多年投入基础设施建设和品牌建设之后，海外业务今年可能实现收支平衡。但其目标不止于卖出更多麻辣烫。杨国福希望向海外消费者介绍中国以食养生的理念、草本食材和文化寓意，同时成为他们日常饮食的一部分。朱承认，有多少文化能随食物一同传播，仍是“一个悬而未决的问题”。Wency Chen 是《南华早报》记者。她目前离开上海驻地，常驻首尔，作为交流项目的一部分同时为《韩国时报》和《南华早报》撰稿。

Unlock these with Subscription The Trump administration is poised to imminently release the findings of a probe aimed at countering alleged excess industrial capacity in 16 major U.S. trading partners, three people with knowledge of the matter said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), with new import duties on a wide range of goods expected. The results of the investigation are expected as soon, these people said. The U.S. Trade Representative’s office is expected to propose new duties that would stack on top of previous tariffs already imposed during President Donald Trump’s second term. It is unclear what tariff rates would be proposed. One of the people said that the duties would be specifically tailored to each country, with goods from Mexico and Norway unlikely to see any immediate levies. USTR has been investigating most of the US’s largest trading partners under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 over what it called evidence of excess industrial capacity. The White House is expected to honor capped tariff rates that were included in finalized US trade deals with partner countries, this person said. These include duty caps of 15% on goods from the EU, Japan and South Korea and 19% for Malaysia. The U.S. also is expected to honor the 20% cap on Trump’s second-term tariffs on goods from China, as long as a trade truce due to expire on January 10 is extended. If it expires, the Chinese excess capacity rate would rise to a higher level. The U.S. Trade Representative’s office and the White House did not respond to Reuters queries about the pending announcement. Ryan Majerus, a former senior Commerce Department trade official, said he expects a lengthy report that could include differentiated tariff remedies for each of the 16 trading partners. Majerus, a partner with King & Spalding, said the administration could propose high tariff rates of 15% to 25% on imports from countries deemed to have excess capacity in various sectors. Those levies would stack on top of existing tariffs of 10% or 12.5% imposed under a separate investigation into lax enforcement of anti-forced labor laws. However, he said the administration could also propose lower tariff rates with escalation clauses that would ratchet rates higher over time unless countries take steps to reduce excess production capacity. The countries included in the probe are China, India, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, Vietnam, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Switzerland, Norway, Singapore, Bangladesh and Cambodia, along with the European Union. The Wall Street Journal reported earlier that the probe’s results could be unveiled as soon as this week. USTR launched the excess capacity probe in March, along with a separate probe into weak or lax enforcement of anti-forced labor laws in 59 countries and the European Union. Together, the duties are meant to rebuild Trump’s global “Liberation Day” tariffs that were struck down by the U.S. Supreme Court in February. The Trump administration has singled out China as the biggest source of excess industrial capacity, which it says is flooding global markets with steel, aluminum, electric vehicles, appliances, solar products and other goods. China has rejected the accusations, saying its exports reflect competitive advantages. The probe is also partly directed at Chinese investment into countries in Southeast Asia, including Vietnam, Indonesia and Cambodia, to manufacture goods for the US market and avoid prior US tariffs. Under a U.S.-China trade truce due to expire on January 10, the Trump administration has capped second-term tariffs on Chinese goods at 20%, in addition to duties of about 25% imposed during Mr. Trump’s first term. The US has already imposed a 12.5% anti-forced labor duty on all Chinese imports, leaving only 7.5% to reach the 20% cap. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — The U.S. State Department on Tuesday stressed the importance of close cooperation with South Korea following President Lee Jae Myung's nomination of new officials to lead the country's foreign policy, intelligence and inter-Korean affairs. On Monday, Lee nominated Lim Woong-soon, currently the second deputy national security adviser, as foreign minister; former Justice Minister Kang Kum-sil as director of the National Intelligence Service (NIS); and former lawmaker Hong Ihk-pyo as unification minister. "The United States values the importance of close cooperation in the U.S.-ROK Alliance," a State Department spokesman said in response to a query from Yonhap News Agency regarding the nominations of new Cabinet members and a new spy chief. ROK stands for the Republic of Korea, South Korea's official name. "We continue to advance U.S. and mutual interests with our ally the ROK," the spokesman said. The nominees are subject to parliamentary confirmation hearings before their formal appointments. The nominations came amid concerns over friction in bilateral intelligence cooperation following Unification Minister Chung Dong-young's disclosure in March of North Korea's Kusong region as one of the sites housing a uranium enrichment facility. The disclosure, made during a parliamentary session, reportedly prompted Washington to restrict Seoul's access to some intelligence on North Korea. In October, the NIS acknowledged that it had been excluded from a June trilateral meeting with the United States and Japan on North Korean cyber threats. The agency, however, maintained that intelligence sharing between Seoul and Washington remained active across a wide range of areas and that the overall volume of intelligence provided by the U.S. had not declined

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国国务院周二强调，在韩国总统李在明提名新官员负责该国外交、情报及韩朝事务后，与韩国密切合作的重要性。周一，李提名现任第二副国家安全顾问林戊勋担任外交部长，前司法部长姜根实担任国家情报院（NIS）院长，前议员洪锡镛担任统一部长。美国国务院发言人在回答韩联社关于新内阁成员及新情报机构负责人提名的提问时说：“美国重视美韩同盟密切合作的重要性。”ROK是韩国的官方名称大韩民国。该发言人说：“我们继续与作为盟友的韩国推进美国和双方的共同利益。”这些提名人选须接受议会确认听证，之后才能正式获任。上述提名出台之际，双边情报合作出现摩擦引发担忧。此前，统一部长郑东永于3月披露，朝鲜龟城地区是铀浓缩设施所在地之一。据报道，这一披露是在一次议会会议上作出的，促使华盛顿限制首尔获取部分有关朝鲜的情报。今年10月，NIS承认，该机构未获准参加6月举行的一次有关朝鲜网络威胁的美日韩三方会议。不过，该机构坚持称，首尔与华盛顿之间的情报交流仍在广泛领域保持活跃，美国提供的情报总量也未减少

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Korea and the United Nations have agreed to establish a joint working group to discuss ways to expand Seoul's contributions to U.N. peacekeeping operations (PKO) following the planned withdrawal of its troops from Lebanon next year, the foreign ministry said Wednesday. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国与联合国周三同意成立联合工作组，讨论在韩国计划于明年从黎巴嫩撤军后，如何扩大韩国对联合国维和行动（PKO）的贡献。外交部表示，工作组将协调东明部队从黎巴嫩安全撤离，并讨论加强韩国参与维和行动的方式。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Korea and the United Nations have agreed to establish a joint working group to discuss ways to expand Seoul's contributions to U.N. peacekeeping operations (PKO) following the planned withdrawal of its troops from Lebanon next year, the foreign ministry said Wednesday. The agreement was reached during separate meetings in New York on Monday (local time) between Chang Wook-jin, the ministry's coordinator-general for international organizations and global affairs, and Mohamed Khaled Khiari, U.N. assistant secretary-general for the Department of Peace Operations, and Atul Khare, under-secretary-general for the Department of Operational Support, according to the ministry. The working group will coordinate the safe withdrawal of the Dongmyeong unit from Lebanon and discuss ways to strengthen Korea's contributions to peacekeeping efforts. The unit is scheduled to withdraw next year following the termination of the U.N. Interim Force in Lebanon's mandate on Dec. 31 under a U.N. Security Council resolution. Chang reaffirmed Seoul's commitment to PKO, noting that Korea has dispatched more than 22,000 peacekeepers since 1993, when it first sent the Sangnoksu unit to Somalia. Khiari highlighted the importance of Korea's contributions in technology and training as U.N. peacekeeping operations face increasingly complex conflicts. He also expressed hope for further deployments of police officers and staff officers. Khare praised Korea's contributions and expressed hope for continued discussions on ways to support peacekeeping operations and capacity building beyond troop deployments, the ministry said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 韩国与联合国同意成立维和贡献问题工作组
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国与联合国已同意成立联合工作组，讨论在韩国计划于明年从黎巴嫩撤军后，扩大首尔对联合国维和行动（PKO）贡献的方式。外交部周三表示，协议是在周一（当地时间）于纽约举行的两次单独会谈中达成的。韩国外交部国际组织及全球事务协调总长张沃金与联合国和平行动部助理秘书长穆罕默德·哈立德·基哈里、联合国行动支助部副秘书长阿图尔·哈雷分别举行了会谈。外交部称，工作组将协调东明部队从黎巴嫩安全撤离，并讨论加强韩国对维和行动贡献的方式。根据联合国安理会决议，联合国驻黎巴嫩临时部队的任务将于12月31日终止，该部队计划于明年撤离。张重申首尔对维和行动的承诺，并指出，自1993年首次向索马里派遣山青部队以来，韩国已派出超过22000名维和人员。基哈里强调，在联合国维和行动面临日益复杂的冲突之际，韩国在技术和培训方面的贡献十分重要。他还希望进一步部署警务人员和参谋人员。外交部表示，哈雷赞扬韩国的贡献，并希望继续讨论除派兵外支持维和行动和能力建设的方式。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: South Korea will offer rewards of up to 500 million won ($370,888) for reporting cheating on the annual college entrance exam, the anti-corruption agency said Monday, as authorities step up efforts to crack down on cheating aided by artificial intelligence (AI). The government will offer 100 million won for each tip-off that leads to the detection of a cheating case, up to a maximum of 500 million won, according to the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC). Those who confess to cheating and report accomplices will also receive the full reward, while facing reduced penalties for their own misconduct, the commission said. "The measure is aimed at safeguarding the fairness and credibility of the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) by encouraging the public to report cheating," it said. The commission is accepting reports of cheating through Jan. 19 as part of a two-month campaign. Last week, authorities said those caught cheating would be barred from taking the exam for 10 years and that rewards of up to 100 million won would be offered for reports of misconduct. The CSAT is the culmination of years of grueling studies for many students and is widely seen as a major life event in South Korea, where the university one goes to can heavily influence career prospects

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The remains of a Korean soldier who died while serving in the Vietnam War will return home, marking the repatriation 59 years after his death, the defense ministry said Wednesday. The ceremony marking the return of late Army Cpl. Ahn Gyu-tae will take place at Seoul Airport in Seongnam, south of Seoul, overseen by Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul, according to the ministry. His remains will be transferred home from Hawaii via the Air Force's C-130 aircraft, it added. Ahn, who served as an Army corporal under the 9th Infantry Division, was deployed to Vietnam in August 1966 in the midst of the war between communist-backed North Vietnam and the United States and its allies, including South Vietnam and Korea. There, he took part in several military operations before he died from a critical gunshot wound that he sustained during a search mission in 1967. He was 23 at the time. His remains were supposed to be returned home via a U.S. transport aircraft, but the plan fell apart as the plane crashed while evading enemy attack on its way to a local airport. Ahn's remains were lost in the process, but they were later found by Vietnamese residents among the 12 sets of remains discovered in the area, and subsequently referred to the U.S. Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency (DPAA). In April, the DPAA, together with the defense ministry's excavation team in charge of searching for the remains of fallen soldiers, identified the remains as those of Ahn after matching genetic samples with his son. The remains will be laid to rest at the national cemetery in the central city of Daejeon on Thursday. It marks the second time the remains of soldiers who died during the Vietnam War have returned home since 2002. The ministry vowed to continue efforts to return the remains of fallen soldiers to their families in cooperation with the U.S

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: 3 institutions agree to collaborate in research, training The Handong International Law School (HILS) and the Handong Institute for Arbitration and Reconciliation (HIAR) have signed a memorandum of understanding with the Korea Mediation Institute (KMI) to expand academic and practical collaboration and enhance students’ mediation skills. Handong Global University said the agreement was signed on Nov. 11 by HILS Dean Lee Hee-eun, HIAR President Shin Eun-joo and KMI President Moon Yong-ho. HILS and HIAR are affiliated with the university. The partnership aims to draw on the expertise and resources of the three institutions to advance mediation education, promote joint research and help develop mediation practices. Under the agreement, the three institutions will jointly develop and offer courses, lectures, workshops and practical programs in mediation and negotiation. They also plan to conduct collaborative research, organize seminars and academic events, and provide students with domestic and international internship opportunities. Other areas of cooperation include sharing academic materials and developing programs that promote constructive approaches to conflict prevention and resolution. “We are deeply honored and delighted to sign our first-ever memorandum of understanding with a law school committed to nurturing the next generation of leaders in mediation in Korea,” KMI President Moon said. He added that KMI would work closely with HILS and HIAR to bridge legal education and mediation practice and foster a culture of dispute resolution through dialogue, negotiation and reconciliation. Founded in April, KMI is a professional organization of mediation experts dedicated to promoting mediation and improving dispute resolution systems. “We hope this partnership will give our students valuable opportunities to gain practical experience in mediation and negotiation and to develop the professional skills needed to become Christian lawyers who are not only strong advocates for their clients but also peacemakers,” HILS Dean Lee said. He emphasized that legal professionals need more than legal knowledge and analytical skills, noting that they must also be able to understand conflicts, consider different perspectives and seek constructive solutions. HIAR President Shin said mediation and reconciliation go beyond simply settling disputes, as they can rebuild trust and lead to sustainable solutions. “Through this partnership, we hope to expand education, research and professional exchanges in mediation and contribute to a broader culture of dialogue and reconciliation,” she said. The university expects the partnership to help students connect legal theory with practical experience and develop the skills to resolve disputes constructively. The initiative also aims to nurture legal professionals who combine legal expertise with the ability to promote dialogue, mutual understanding and reconciliation
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 汉东大学与韩国调解研究院合作推广调解教育
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh:
3家机构达成合作，开展研究与培训

汉东国际法学院（HILS）、汉东仲裁与和解研究院（HIAR）与韩国调解院（KMI）签署了一份谅解备忘录，以扩大学术和实务合作，并提升学生的调解技能。汉东全球大学表示，该协议于11月11日签署，签署方为HILS院长李希恩、HIAR院长申恩珠以及KMI院长文镛浩。HILS和HIAR均隶属于该大学。

此次合作旨在利用三家机构的专业知识和资源，推进调解教育、促进联合研究，并帮助发展调解实务。根据协议，三家机构将联合开发并开设调解与谈判方面的课程、讲座、研讨班和实践项目。它们还计划开展合作研究、组织研讨会和学术活动，并为学生提供国内及国际实习机会。其他合作领域还包括共享学术资料，以及开发促进以建设性方式预防和解决冲突的项目。

KMI院长文镛浩说：“我们深感荣幸，也十分高兴与一所致力于培养韩国下一代调解领袖的法学院签署首份谅解备忘录。”他补充说，KMI将与HILS和HIAR密切合作，架起法律教育与调解实务之间的桥梁，通过对话、谈判与和解培育争端解决文化。

KMI成立于4月，是一家由调解专家组成的专业组织，致力于推广调解并改进争端解决制度。HILS院长李希恩说：“我们希望此次合作能为我们的学生提供宝贵机会，使其积累调解与谈判的实践经验，并培养成为基督徒律师所需的专业技能。他们不仅应成为客户的有力代言人，也应成为缔造和平的人。”他强调，法律专业人士不仅需要法律知识和分析能力，还必须能够理解冲突、审视不同立场，并寻求建设性解决方案。

HIAR院长申恩珠说，调解与和解不仅仅是解决争端，还可以重建信任，带来可持续的解决方案。她说：“通过此次合作，我们希望扩大调解领域的教育、研究和专业交流，并为形成更广泛的对话与和解文化作出贡献。”

汉东全球大学预计，此次合作将帮助学生将法律理论与实践经验相结合，培养以建设性方式解决争端的能力。该计划还旨在培养兼具法律专业能力，以及推动对话、相互理解和和解能力的法律专业人士

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary: Exports of Korean beauty, food, fashion and cultural products hit a record high amid the global popularity of Korean culture as the country's total exports surpassed $1 trillion for the first time, customs data showed Wednesday. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary_zh: 韩国海关数据显示，随着韩国文化在全球日益流行，韩国美容、食品、时尚和文化产品的出口额周三创下历史新高，该国总出口额首次突破1万亿美元。韩国关税厅数据显示，从1月至周四实现这一出口里程碑之际，韩国此类消费品发货总额达到286.5亿美元。这占消费品出口总额的47.6%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: Exports of Korean beauty, food, fashion and cultural products hit a record high amid the global popularity of Korean culture as the country's total exports surpassed $1 trillion for the first time, customs data showed Wednesday. Shipments of such Korean consumer goods totaled $28.65 billion from January through Thursday, when the country hit the export milestone, according to data from the Korea Customs Service. The figure marked a 21.5 percent spike from the same period last year and already surpassed last year's full-year total of $27.02 billion. Exports of beauty products surged 34.6 percent on-year to $13.65 billion over the cited period on steady demand for Korean cosmetics. This accounted for 47.6 percent of total consumer goods exports. In 2025, exports of beauty products totaled $11.61 billion, accounting for 43 percent of the total. Outbound shipments of Korean food increased 9.3 percent to $10.94 billion, driven by strong sales of "ramyeon," or instant noodles, and marine products. Exports of fashion items totaled $3.13 billion, up 14 percent from a year earlier, while those of cultural goods, such as albums and books, increased 36.5 percent to $920 million over the cited period. By country, the United States was the biggest buyer of Korean consumer goods, importing $5.69 billion, surpassing China's purchases of $5.1 billion for the first time in 22 years
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title_zh: 受韩国文化热潮带动，韩国消费品出口创下历史新高
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 韩国文化在全球日益流行的背景下，韩国美容、食品、时尚和文化产品出口额再创新高。韩国关税周三公布的数据显示，该国出口总额首次突破1万亿美元。今年1月至周四，韩国这类消费品的出口额达286.5亿美元；韩国关税数据显示，该国于周四实现了这一出口里程碑。这一数字较去年同期增长21.5%，并已超过去年全年270.2亿美元的总出口额。由于韩国化妆品需求持续稳定，美容产品出口额在上述期间同比增长34.6%，达到136.5亿美元，占消费品出口总额的47.6%。2025年，美容产品出口总额为116.1亿美元，占总额的43%。在“拉面”或方便面以及海产品销量强劲的推动下，韩国食品出口额增长9.3%，达到109.4亿美元。时尚产品出口额为31.3亿美元，较上年同期增长14%；专辑、图书等文化产品在上述期间的出口额增长36.5%，达到9.2亿美元。按国家划分，美国是韩国消费品最大的买家，进口额为56.9亿美元，首次超过中国，22年来首次出现这种情况；同期中国采购额为51亿美元

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea condemned Switzerland on Tuesday for sanctioning a North Korean children's camp over the transfer of children from Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine and said it would consider shutting down the Swiss diplomatic office in Pyongyang, state media said. North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's influential sister, Kim Yo Jong, said the Swiss sanctions infringed on the country's sovereignty and demonstrated hostility towards Pyongyang, KCNA state news agency reported. Voice of America reported last week that Switzerland had added North Korea's Songdowon International Children's Camp to its sanctions list for cooperating with Russia-linked groups to transfer children from Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine. The sanctions deny North Korea's obligation to provide all children with opportunities for culture and recreation and leave "an indelible stain" on its international reputation as a country that promotes humanitarianism, Kim Yo Jong said in a statement. "I deem it necessary to comprehensively reconsider the relations with unreliable Switzerland, whose deeds do not agree with its words," Kim was quoted as saying by KCNA. "Its aim is to maintain channels of dialogue, including with states with which we have differences on certain issues," it said in emailed comments. In October, North Korea hosted the Swiss foreign minister and the two sides agreed to promote dialogue and cooperation. Switzerland also recently opened a diplomatic office in Pyongyang. North Korea has dramatically advanced ties with Russia since 2023 and is believed to have shipped weapons and troops to help Moscow in the war against Ukraine under a comprehensive partnership treaty their leaders signed in 2024

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 朝鲜周二谴责瑞士制裁朝鲜一所儿童营，理由是该营参与将儿童从俄罗斯占领的乌克兰地区转移，并表示将考虑关闭瑞士驻平壤外交办事处。朝鲜国家媒体报道称，朝鲜领导人金正恩极具影响力的妹妹金与正表示，瑞士的制裁侵犯了朝鲜主权，表现出对平壤的敌意。朝鲜通讯社报道称，美国之的上周报道，瑞士已将朝鲜松都国际儿童营列入制裁名单，原因是该营与俄罗斯关联团体合作，将儿童从俄罗斯占领的乌克兰地区转移出去。金与正在声明中说，这些制裁剥夺了朝鲜为所有儿童提供文化和休闲机会的责任，并在这个宣扬人道主义的国家国际声誉上留下“无法抹去的污点”。朝鲜通讯社援引金与正的话说：“我认为有必要全面重新审视与不可靠的瑞士的关系，因为瑞士的所作所为与其言辞并不一致。”该社在通过电子邮件发表的评论中说：“瑞士的目的是维持对话渠道，包括与我们在某些问题上存在分歧的国家维持对话渠道。”今年10月，朝鲜接待了瑞士外长，双方同意推动对话与合作。瑞士最近还在平壤开设了外交办事处。自2023年以来，朝鲜大幅推进与俄罗斯的关系。据信，朝鲜依据两国领导人在2024年签署的全面伙伴关系条约，向俄罗斯运送了武器和士兵，以协助莫斯科在乌克兰战争中作战。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Can renewable energy really get cheaper?
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: The International Energy Agency expects global data center electricity consumption to more than double by 2030 as artificial intelligence (AI) spreads. Yet Korea imports more than 90 percent of its energy. Renewable energy, however, has long carried a familiar label: "clean, but expensive." Is that still true?
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 随着人工智能（AI）不断普及，国际能源署预计，到2030年，全球数据中心的用电量将增至两倍以上。然而，韩国超过90%的能源依赖进口。可再生能源长期以来却一直背负着一个熟悉的标签：“清洁，但昂贵。”如今这是否仍是事实？
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: Every time you ask a chatbot a question, a data center somewhere uses electricity. The International Energy Agency expects global data center electricity consumption to more than double by 2030 as artificial intelligence (AI) spreads. That would be more electricity than the entire country of Japan uses today. In the United States, people living near clusters of data centers are angry as their household electricity bills rise. In Europe, some factories are shutting down because power has become too expensive. The cost of electricity is becoming everyone's problem. Korea is no exception. New semiconductor factories and AI data centers are driving electricity demand up again. Yet Korea imports more than 90 percent of its energy. How we balance coal, nuclear, natural gas and renewables in our power mix will have a major impact on electricity bills in the years ahead. Renewable energy, however, has long carried a familiar label: "clean, but expensive." Is that still true? Imagine a new solar farm being built in a field in Germany. Add up all the costs of building and operating it over its lifetime, then divide that figure by the total amount of electricity it will generate. The result is between 41 and 69 euros per megawatt-hour (MWh). Now imagine building a new gas-fired power plant right next door. Once fuel costs and the cost of carbon emissions are included, its electricity costs between 110 and 180 euros per MWh. The average wholesale electricity price is around 86 euros. In the race to produce cheaper electricity, new solar power plants are already ahead. But something unusual happened in Spain this March. On sunny days around noon, solar farms across the country generated huge amounts of electricity at the same time. It's like every farmer bringing watermelons to market on the same day: when supply floods the market, prices collapse. That month, Spanish solar power sold for an average of just 13.51 euros per MWh, less than half the cost of producing it. Meanwhile, in Italy, where solar power makes up a much smaller share of electricity generation, solar producers earned 124.72 euros per MWh over the same period. Europe is tackling this problem in two ways. First, it is using batteries to store excess electricity generated at midday and release it in the evening, when demand is higher. Second, it is encouraging long-term contracts that guarantee a fixed selling price in advance. For a solar company here, simply finding land for a solar farm can be a major challenge. Land is also one of the biggest components of project costs. Smaller projects mean less opportunity to benefit from economies of scale, making equipment and construction more expensive. And with so much uncertainty about future revenue, banks charge higher interest rates. As a result, renewable electricity sold through government auctions in Korea costs around 150 won per kilowatt-hour (kWh), well above the wholesale market price of about 90 won. But the solution lies in addressing those very obstacles. If the government secures land in advance, combines smaller projects into larger sites and supports long-term contracts that provide stable revenue, the cost of solar power could fall to around 70 won per kWh. Starting next year, the existing support program will also come to an end, with projects selected through price-based competition. Let's return to the question we started with. In the age of AI, electricity demand will keep growing, and pressure on power bills is unlikely to disappear. Europe's answer is yes — but only if the right conditions are in place. The cost of generating electricity at new solar farms has already fallen dramatically. The remaining challenge is to build the systems that can deliver that low-cost electricity to consumers at affordable prices. In the age of AI, the winner won't simply be the country that can generate the cheapest electricity. It will be the country that builds the infrastructure and market systems needed to turn cheap power into lower electricity bills. Moon Go-young is co-CEO of the Korean unit of RWE, the German global energy company. He also serves as chairman of the Korea Foreign Company Association. He is an energy specialist who spent more than two decades at LG, LS, POSCO and Hanyang developing and commercializing fuel cells, waste-to-energy, solar power and energy storage
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 可再生能源真能变得更便宜吗？
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 每当你向聊天机器人提问时，某个数据中心就会消耗电力。随着人工智能（AI）不断普及，国际能源署预计，到2030年，全球数据中心的用电量将增至现在的两倍以上。这将超过日本目前整个国家的用电量。在美国，居住在大片数据中心附近的人们因家庭电费上涨而愤怒。在欧洲，由于电价过高，一些工厂正在停工。电费正成为每个人的问题。韩国也不例外。新建的半导体工厂和人工智能数据中心再次推高了用电需求。然而，韩国90%以上的能源依赖进口。未来几年，我们的电力结构如何平衡煤炭、核能、天然气和可再生能源，将对电费产生重大影响。然而，可再生能源长期以来一直背负着一个熟悉的标签：“清洁，但昂贵”。现在这仍然成立吗？想象一下，德国的一片田地里正在建设一座新的太阳能电站。把它整个生命周期内的建设和运营成本全部加起来，再除以它将生产的全部电量，结果是每兆瓦时（MWh）41至69欧元。现在再想象一下，就在旁边建设一座新的燃气发电厂。把燃料成本和碳排放成本计算在内，其发电成本为每兆瓦时110至180欧元。平均批发电价约为每兆瓦时86欧元。在以更低成本发电的竞争中，新建太阳能电站已经领先。但今年3月，西班牙发生了一件不同寻常的事。在晴朗日子里的正午前后，全国各地的太阳能电站同时产生了大量电力。这就像所有农民都在同一天把西瓜运到市场：当供应充斥市场时，价格便会暴跌。当月，西班牙太阳能电力的平均售价仅为每兆瓦时13.51欧元，不到生产成本的一半。与此同时，在太阳能发电占发电量比例小得多的意大利，同期太阳能发电商每兆瓦时获得124.72欧元。欧洲正从两个方面应对这一问题。第一，利用电池储存中午产生的多余电力，并在傍晚需求较高时释放。第二，鼓励签订预先锁定固定售价的长期合同。对这里的太阳能企业而言，仅是为太阳能电站寻找土地就可能是一项重大挑战。土地也是项目成本中最大的组成部分之一。项目规模较小，就更难发挥规模经济优势，从而抬高设备和施工成本。而未来收入存在如此大的不确定性，银行便收取更高的利率。因此，在韩国通过政府拍卖出售的可再生电力价格约为每千瓦时（kWh）150韩元，远高于约90韩元的批发市场价格。但解决办法恰恰在于消除这些障碍。如果政府预先取得土地，把较小的项目整合为较大的项目，并支持能够提供稳定收入的长期合同，太阳能发电成本就可能降至每千瓦时约70韩元。从明年开始，现有的支持计划也将结束，入选项目将改为通过价格竞争产生。让我们回到最初的问题。在人工智能时代，用电需求将持续增长，电费压力也不太可能消失。欧洲给出的答案是肯定的——但前提是具备适当条件。新建太阳能电站的发电成本已经大幅下降。剩下的挑战，是建设能够以消费者负担得起的价格，把这些低成本电力输送出去的系统和市场。在人工智能时代，获胜者不只是能够以最低成本发电的国家，而是能够建设必要的基础设施和市场体系、将廉价电力转化为更低电费的国家。Moon Go-young是德国全球能源公司RWE韩国业务部门的联席首席执行官。他还担任韩国外国公司协会会长。他是一位能源专家，曾在LG、LS、POSCO和Hanyang工作二十多年，推动燃料电池、垃圾能源转化、太阳能发电和储能技术的开发与商业化

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 韩国央行的一项调查显示，受销售疲软和库存增加等因素影响，韩国企业景气指数11月份五个月来首次下降。韩国银行（BOK）数据显示，11月全行业综合企业景气指数（CBSI）为103.5，较上月下降0.7点。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korea's business sentiment fell for the first time in five months in November due mainly to sluggish sales and rising inventory, a central bank survey showed Wednesday. The Composite Business Sentiment Index (CBSI) for all industries stood at 103.5 in November, down 0.7 point from the previous month, according to data from the Bank of Korea (BOK). The reading marked the first on-month decline since June, when the index dropped 1.2 points. The index measures corporate outlooks on overall business conditions, with a reading above 100 indicating that optimists still outnumber pessimists. The CBSI among manufacturers fell 0.8 point on-month to 104.8 in November from a more than four-year high of 105.6 the previous month. The manufacturing index had remained above the 100 mark for four consecutive months from May through August, after first topping the threshold in May for the first time since August 2022, but fell to 99.5 in September. The index among nonmanufacturers also went down 0.7 point on-month to 102.5. The BOK said rising inventory and global oversupply weighed on manufacturing companies, while nonmanufacturing companies turned less optimistic due to higher energy costs and fewer leisure activities amid colder weather. The outlook for December climbed 0.2 point to 102 from the previous month's projection of 101.8, the survey showed. The economic sentiment index, or ESI, which reflects sentiment among both consumers and businesses, contracted 0.9 point to 99.9 for November
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 商业景气度五个月来首次下降
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国央行的一项调查显示，受销售疲软和库存上升等因素影响，韩国企业景气指数11月五个月来首次下降。根据韩国央行（BOK）的数据，11月全行业综合企业景气指数（CBSI）为103.5，较上月下降0.7点。这一读数是自6月以来该指数首次环比下滑，当月指数曾下跌1.2点。该指数衡量企业对整体经营状况的预期，100以上的读数表明乐观者仍多于悲观者。11月制造业企业景气指数环比下降0.8点至104.8，上月该指数曾创下四年多来的高位105.6。该制造业指数从5月至8月连续四个月保持在100以上；5月该指数自2022年8月以来首次突破这一门槛，但9月降至99.5。非制造业企业景气指数也环比下降0.7点至102.5。韩国央行表示，库存上升和全球供应过剩对制造企业造成压力，而非制造业企业则因能源成本上升以及天气转冷导致休闲活动减少而降低了乐观程度。调查显示，12月预期指数从前一个月的101.8上升0.2点至102。反映消费者和企业双方情绪的经济景气指数（ESI）11月收缩0.9点至99.9

All three labor unions at Seoul Metro, which operates subway Lines 1-8 and part of Line 9, reached agreements with management and called off their planned general strike, which had been scheduled to begin with the first trains of the day. Despite the unions' demands, Seoul Metro had maintained that workforce restructuring is necessary to ensure an appropriate staffing level, citing its financial burden and the need to improve operational efficiency. "Seoul Metro is currently short of about 800 workers, and we have agreed to hire some 500 new employees. We will work to speed up recruitment to ensure the safety of subway passengers and operations and help create jobs for young people," said Kim Jeong-seop, head of Union 1, Seoul Metro's largest union
